Mushrooms Blockade.scenario: You step into a clearing of towering mushrooms. Their glowing caps slowly swivel, tracking your every movement.

best: The mushrooms assume you are one of them. They open the way for you to go on through.
neutral: The mushrooms are not pleased and put up a fight, but you manage to make it through after a while.
worst: The mushrooms find you funny but after a long time decide you’re kind of pathetic and finally let you through.

The Annual Snail Parade.scenario: You stumble into the 14th Annual Snail Procession. Tiny banners wave as the snails march with serious determination.

worst: The snails move extremely slow… you wasted a lot of time.
best: The snails are angered by your interruption, but they are too slow to catch up.
neutral: You are handed a banner and the snails feel inspired, they barely moved any faster though.

Floral Grasp.scenario: You enter a field of delicate flowers. Their stems gently curl around your ankles, tightening just enough to anchor you in place

worst: Congratulations, you are now trapped and take forever to rip off all of the flowers.
best: The flowers loosened, they release you and create a beautiful pathway.
neutral: They loosened slightly, impressed by your patience, but it does take a while.

The Wolf Guardian.scenario: A giant armored wolf holding a massive sword steps forward and blocks your path.

worst: He is strictly professional and finds this extremely disrespectful. He claws your hand and roars.
best: Despite everything, he is still a wolf. Instincts surpass honor, he playfully runs after it, making an opening.
neutral: He accepts. It is an exhausting fight and you sustain injuries, but he guides you along as a reward.

The Angry Shroombear.scenario: A massive bear rears up before you, claws flashing in the moonlight.

best: A giant fish flew out of its mouth, it was choking and only wanted your help. It shows you a shortcut.
worst: The bear gets annoyed and claws at you.
neutral: It’s confused. You’re confused. The bear walks away in confusion.

The Mirror-Image Duel.scenario: You reach a crystal-clear pond where your reflection climbs out, intent on taking your place in the real world.

worst: It copies you perfectly. You both lose respect for yourselves and sit there in silence for a while.
best: It dramatically fades, “I was cooler” You win anyway.
neutral: It mirrors every move. Eventually, this tires it out after a long battle.

The Merchant.scenario: Gilbert the frog in a tiny coat sits behind a crooked wooden stall. 'Greetings, travelers... care to improve your survival odds? I have a few items available.'

option 1: Gain extra time on one future decision
option 3: Reveals which option is safest in a future scenario

Fairy Fountain.scenario: Magical forest fairies greet you before a glowing fountain, offering a blessing for finding their hidden sanctuary.

option 1: Heals you of all your ailments
option 2: Reveal the worst option on a decision

The Gardener.scenario: Tobias the forest florist tends to his magical flowers and offers you one hiding a mysterious reward.

option 1: Heals you of all your ailments

The Statue of the Greedy King.scenario: A golden statue blocks the path, its mouth open. It will only move if it 'tastes' something incredibly valuable

option 1: Lose the ability to choose answer one
option 2: Lose the ability to choose answer three
option 3: Lose the ability to choose answer two

The Glowing Bridge.scenario: A narrow bridge made of shimmering blue light stretches over a bottomless ravine, its glow flickering unpredictably.

option 1: Drop your items to reduce weight

The Illuminated Portal.scenario: A mesmerizing portal hums in the woods, pulling at your mind. You cannot look away unless you please it.

The Goblin Interns.scenario: Three goblins in oversized business suits hand out aggressively professional flyers.

worst: Take a flyer and encourage them
The goblins were secretly working for the wizard and the flyers were coated with magic that traps you briefly.
best: The goblins panic, they were secretly working for the wizard to sabotage you. You have successfully thwarted their attempt.
neutral: Listen to their long sales pitch
The goblins trap you there for a long time, this was all a set up to stall for the wizard and you fell for it but you managed to get out of there.

The Sad Cheese Seller.scenario: A tiny mouse chef sits behind a lonely cheese cart. 'No one believes in artisanal forest cheese anymore...'

neutral: It looks amazing. Still no customers, but he does help you move along although you wasted some time.
worst: He already doubts himself. He spent a long time crying about his problems and you felt like it was too rude to leave.
best: It is incredible. You feel inspired, thanking him and gaining a new found speed.

The Whimsical Tree.scenario: An ancient and mythical tree blocks your path. 'Answer my riddle,' it booms. 'I am always hungry, I must be fed. The finger I touch soon turns red.

neutral: The tree nods slowly. “Acceptable.” A path opens up.
best: “Correct,” it says, pleased you chose something poetic. A shortcut is revealed.
worst: “No,” it sighs. “Not very smart…” It forces you to go a different path.

Trapped Ogre.scenario: An ogre has fallen into a deep pit. 'HEY... little help here?' A glowing potion rests just outside the hole.

helpful: He says thanks, then remembers he’s an ogre and smacks you over the head. He then leaves out of respect.
selfish: Finders keepers. The ogre respects the hustle.
You try to grab the potion, but slip and fall in the hole too. The ogre knocks you out and then leaves the hole. You're stuck there for a while.

Abandoned Cart.scenario: A gnome's cart sits against a tree, a goblin is taking items from it and ushers you to help while the gnome doesn't notice.

helpful: Yell to the gnome and warn him
The goblin flees. The gnome cries, thanking you and heals your injuries.
selfish: Raid the cart with the goblin
The goblin judges your technique. You feel weirdly inadequate, but manage to find a potion to heal your injuries.
The goblin is mad that you're stealing his loot, and he throws a potion that immobilizes you for a while.

Witch's Soup.scenario: A witch stirs a bubbling pond of tadpoles. She claims she means no harm, they're only for soup.

helpful: The tadpoles respect you and open up a secret path in the pond, you lose a little time helping them but not too much.
selfish: The soup invigorates you, giving you the energy to keep moving foward quickly.
It’s really bad and you feel sick. You manage to heal your injuries but you lost some time.
